meta.note: Frequency is derived from the loop, not measured by simulation.

weekly_advance_order.action: enforce_pre_fight_medicals — cancel bouts the commission blocks
check blocking athletes — fights due today must be attended
1/7 slice of training/body effects from week_program or training_focus
retention, requests, rivalries, media, short-notice (1/7 chance each)
auto-resolve world bouts the player did not watch
apply week_program slices if set (per-day training plan)
morale drift based on health, fatigue, recent results
remaining unticked days of daily systems
combo tightness decay for anyone who skipped mitts
camp week progression for fighters in camp
accrue payroll/upkeep, bill on month turn
increment week counter, reset day to 0
Grand Prix nights and new announcements

decisions.decision: weekly training focus for an athlete (ring/bags/strength/cardio/recovery/rest)
decisions.when: every week, before Sunday rollover
decisions.default_if_never_made: rest — the athlete rests for the week (line 5232: resolved_focus = 'rest' if requested_focus.is_empty())

decisions.decision: per-day training program for an athlete (7 days, each a focus + station)
decisions.when: every week, overrides legacy training_focus when set
decisions.default_if_never_made: falls through to legacy training_focus or rest if neither is set

decisions.decision: which technique to train this week (Move Lab session)
decisions.when: before the week the technique session should resolve
decisions.default_if_never_made: no technique training — empty string, the branch is skipped entirely
decisions.how_often: per technique session, several per year

decisions.decision: which discipline program to enter (including MMA transition)
decisions.when: before the week the discipline program should resolve
decisions.default_if_never_made: no discipline training — empty string, the branch is skipped
decisions.how_often: per discipline program, rare (MMA transitions etc.)

decisions.decision: which fight offer to book for an athlete
decisions.when: any week before the fight week; blocks advance_week if due this week and unattended
decisions.default_if_never_made: no fight booked — the athlete trains or rests normally that week
decisions.how_often: per fight, roughly monthly per active athlete

decisions.decision: fight plan (balanced/striking/grappling) at booking time
decisions.writer: book_fight() parameter, player chooses at booking
decisions.when: at booking time, frozen onto the contract
decisions.default_if_never_made: balanced — the function signature default (line 10654: plan_id: String = "balanced")

decisions.decision: weight cut diet plan (none/moderate/aggressive) for a booked fighter
decisions.when: before the weigh-in (week of fight or week before)
decisions.default_if_never_made: moderate — line 1847: str(athlete.get("weight_cut_plan", "moderate"))

decisions.decision: target weight class for a division change
decisions.when: any week; blocks booking until complete or cancelled
decisions.default_if_never_made: no move — fighter stays in current weight class permanently

decisions.decision: accept or ignore a sponsorship offer
decisions.when: when offer is available, before it expires
decisions.default_if_never_made: no sponsor — no sponsorship income, the slot rotates to another offer
decisions.how_often: per offer cycle, several per year

decisions.decision: sign an exclusive promotional contract with an organization
decisions.when: when offer available; turns the fighter pro (irreversible)
decisions.default_if_never_made: free agent — can fight on any card but no promotional backing

decisions.decision: accept a bout offered by the fighter's promotion
decisions.when: when bout is on the promotion's slate
decisions.default_if_never_made: bout not booked — no direct penalty, but declining (active choice) costs standing

decisions.decision: accept a contract renewal offer for a fighter whose contract expired
decisions.when: when contract expires, before offer window (RETENTION_OFFER_WINDOW_WEEKS) elapses
decisions.default_if_never_made: offer lapses — fighter leaves the gym (line 6832-6838: 'contract expired without an extension')

decisions.decision: sign a recruitment candidate (athlete or coach) to the gym
decisions.when: when candidate is available in the scouting pool
decisions.default_if_never_made: candidate not signed — they remain in the world pool

decisions.decision: propose salary/contract weeks/role during contract negotiation
decisions.when: during negotiation, before finalize_negotiated_signing()
decisions.default_if_never_made: negotiation never completes — candidate not signed

decisions.decision: buy a piece of gym equipment for the floor
decisions.when: any time, requires funds and floor space
decisions.default_if_never_made: no equipment — training stations limited to what was starter kit

decisions.decision: assign a coach to an athlete
decisions.when: when coach and athlete available
decisions.default_if_never_made: no coach assigned — no coach bonus to training

decisions.decision: release a coach from the staff
decisions.when: any time
decisions.default_if_never_made: coach stays on payroll indefinitely

decisions.decision: select the gym's active ruleset (boxing/MMA/kickboxing/etc.)
decisions.when: any time, affects booking and fight plan availability
decisions.default_if_never_made: boxing — line 217: var selected_ruleset_id: String = "boxing"

decisions.decision: take a short-notice fight on an upcoming card
decisions.when: when card has an open short-notice slot
decisions.default_if_never_made: slot passes — filled by world fighter or scratched (line 8660: pass_short_notice)

decisions.decision: accept a seat in a Grand Prix tournament
decisions.when: when GP event is announced and seat is available
decisions.default_if_never_made: seat forfeited — goes to another fighter

decisions.decision: accept a Contender Series showcase invite
decisions.when: when invite is available
decisions.default_if_never_made: invite expires — no showcase bout, no contract opportunity

decisions.decision: respond to a fighter request (retirement, time off, money, exit)
decisions.when: when request is open, before deadline or ignore_weeks (4 weeks)
decisions.default_if_never_made: ignored after 4 weeks — morale -6, grudge +6 (line 7259: _resolve_request with 'ignored', line 7122: ignored_morale=-6, ignored_grudge=6)

decisions.decision: attend (watch live) a booked fight on fight day
decisions.when: on fight day — HARD GATE: advance_day refuses until fight is attended
decisions.default_if_never_made: BLOCKED — the day and week cannot advance (line 5020: 'ATTEND TODAY'S FIGHT BEFORE THE DAY ENDS')

decisions.decision: watch an undercard bout on a world event card
decisions.when: on event day, before the day resolves
decisions.default_if_never_made: auto-resolved by WorldPopulation.advance_world (line 2730) — the bout happens, results apply, but the player had no say in the viewing
decisions.how_often: per undercard bout on cards the roster fights on

book.description: From offer selection to fight night, the booking pipeline

steps.action: get_fight_offer() / get_organization_fight_offer() — present available offers
book_fight(athlete_id, offer_id, plan_id) — validate, freeze terms, stamp booked_fight
advance_week reads booked_fight — blocks if due and unattended
_advance_fight_camps — camp week progression for booked fighter
_advance_weight_cuts — diet progression per weight_cut_plan
_resolve_weigh_ins — weigh-in resolves day before bout
advance_day blocks on fight day — must attend

train.description: From training assignment to body effect resolution

steps.action: assign_training(athlete_id, focus) — set weekly focus + station
set_week_program_day(athlete_id, day, focus, station_id) — per-day plan
assign_technique_training(athlete_id, technique_id) — Move Lab session
assign_discipline_training(athlete_id, discipline_id) — discipline program
_apply_daily_training_tick — 1/7 slice per day
advance_week resolves remaining slices + injury roll + morale
assign_coach(athlete_id, coach_id) — coach bonus to training

watch.description: From fight night to result settlement

steps.action: advance_day blocks on fight day — player must attend
FightSimulation runs — produces sim_result
record_live_fight_result(athlete_id, offer_id, sim_result) — freeze pending_fight_result
steps.surface: NO SURFACE — called by fight viewer

steps.action: _apply_fight_result — settle purse, record, injuries at week rollover
record_watched_world_bout — watch undercard bouts
_resolve_unwatched_events_for_day — auto-resolve unwatched bouts
